Range) |pvp_speed = 5.5 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision & Splash only) |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Railgun Tank''' is the fifth and final vehicle that spawns from the [[Military Base]], spawning when the [[Military Base]] is at Level 5. It can also be spawned by the [[War Machine]] when it uses its ''Convoy'' Ability. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Railgun Tank''' has a spawnrate of 35 seconds. Like the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]], the '''Railgun Tank''' has a gun that can deal damage to enemies. Additionally, the '''Railgun Tank''' has a pulse cannon that can be used to deal splash damage to enemies. These can detect hidden enemies, but not flying enemies. The cannon can damage lead enemies, but the '''Tank's''' gun cannot. There is a limit of three units per [[Military Base]], limiting the amount of '''Railgun Tanks''' that can spawn. However, this should generally not be an issue, due to how hard it is to reach this limit. ==Appearance== The current version of the '''Railgun Tank''' is a AbramsX tank with blue accents and multiple neon blue lights. It has a pulse cannon mounted on it. Its caterpillar tracks are covered by armor. There are two antennas on the back of the vehicle. There is a mounted machine gun on the top of the tank. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:ClassicRailgunTank2.png|175px]] |[[File:WastelandRailgunTank.png|175px]] |[[File:CyberRailgunTank.png|175px]] |[[File:Base1776RailgunTank.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Premium|Classic}} |{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} |{{Color|Deluxe|Cyber}} |{{Color|Patriotic|Base 1776}} |- !Obtained From |[[Premium Crate]] |[[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Deluxe Crate]] |''🦅 Eagle Screech'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]],
[[Patriotic Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceCreamRailgunTank.png|175px]] |[[File:PirateRailgunTank.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Ice Cream}} |{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Railgun Tank''' is great for hordes with high health [[enemies]], like the [[Slow Boss]], [[Speedy Boss]] and [[Molten Golem]]. **The '''Railgun Tank''' even fares quite well against other high health enemies that certain towers struggle against, like the [[Fallen Tank]] and [[Fallen Guardian]]. **The '''Railgun Tank''' cannot be stunned, so it is quite useful against major bosses, like the [[Fallen King]]. ***However, the '''Railgun Tank''' can be damaged by abilities that damage [[units]], like the [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]. ****It is left severely weakened by some enemies (like the [[Brute]]) and is completely destroyed by others (like the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]). *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Railgun Tank''' will spawn per Level 5 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Railgun Tank''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Bulwark]] and [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]. **Its cannon and explosion upon destruction can also deal full damage to enemies with defense. **While the '''Railgun Tank''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, the damage from its gun is decreased. *The '''Railgun Tank's''' splash damage (through its cannon or upon its destruction) cannot damage enemies that are immune to splash damage, like the [[Wraith]]. **However, the '''Railgun Tank''' can still deal collision damage, as well as gun damage, against these enemies as long as they are detectable or collidable. *The '''Railgun Tank's''' gun and cannon can detect hidden enemies, but they cannot detect flying enemies. **Flying enemies can still be hit indirectly through its explosions. **The '''Railgun Tank''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]]. *The '''Railgun Tank''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. ==Trivia== *The first version of the '''Railgun Tank''' appears as the [[Military Base]] Level 5 upgrade icon. *Although the '''Railgun Tank's''' beam from its pulse cannon is an electrical beam similar to the [[Electroshocker]], it does not stun enemies. *The '''Railgun Tank''' is the first unit to be spawned by more than one tower, those being the [[Military Base]] and [[War Machine]]. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''10 July 2019''' -
